descriptionPerTier.1:
Deals 50% of your skill's base damage as additional andermagic damage
There is a 20% chance that the hit enemy gets corrupted by the andermagic. The corruption increases the damage of the enemy by 10%. This effect can be stacked up to 10 times.
There is a 0.5% chance that the hit enemy gets a corruption overdose. The corruption overdose increases the damage and resistances of the enemy by 100%. It becomes immune to all normal atacks and can only be damaged by using the Essence of Vigor (Andermagic). (Does not work on other players).
No effect in offical arenas.
